reviews.title: One of my favorite cases
reviews.comment:
Great case, doesn’t take up a lot of room on my desk but has plenty of room inside the case for large cards and other accessories and looks really really good 
Also hard not to mention how good my temps are in the case, I’ve had it for 2 years now and I don't think I’ve had any issues with temps and air flow
